description: Eight independent sample and hold or track and hold rows, each with its own chance, scale and offset

params.text: Chooses whether that row takes one sample on a trigger and holds it, or passes its input through for as long as the gate is high
Sets the chance that an incoming trigger on that row takes a sample at all, 0% to 100%
Scales that row's held voltage before it leaves, -100% to +100%
Adds a fixed voltage to that row's held value, -10V to +10V

inputs.text: Takes a sample on each rising edge in Sample & Hold, or opens that row's track for as long as it is high in Track & Hold
The signal that row samples; with nothing patched a ±5V noise source is sampled instead

outputs.text: That row's held voltage, scaled and offset

notes: a row with nothing in its IN jack samples the module's own white noise, which is how it doubles as a random voltage source.
there is no trigger output on this version, and no attenuverter or CV jack on any row.
menu: Full — makes the built-in noise an even spread of random voltages between -5V and +5V
Centered — weights the built-in noise towards the middle, and it can step outside ±5V now and then
Sample on HIGH Gate — turns Track & Hold round on every row, so the signal passes while the gate is low and is held while it is high
